items.title: Stored cross-site scripting through rich-text comment markup
Comment script runs inside the moderator admin screen and abuses moderator powers
Automated accounts flood product pages with spam and phishing links
Comment delete endpoint may not verify the caller is a moderator
Attacker-chosen image URLs in comments report every visitor to the attacker's server
Cross-site request forgery makes a victim post or delete comments unknowingly
Unauthenticated endpoint abused for resource exhaustion
